note: Citation anchors for packages/kimi-agent/ROADMAP.md. Each entry names the 'cited' literal as it appears in the ledger, the tree it resolves in (worktree / upstream / retired), and the symbol expected at that location. scripts/check-roadmap-refs.mjs verifies each anchored citation; UNANCHORED citations are counted but never fail. The full manifest is deliberately partial: the gate reports its coverage, so the gap is measured rather than hidden. See the validator's header for the four citation shapes this design exists to handle.
coverageNote: 25 of 194 line-carrying citations the extractor can see (plus an unknown number it cannot see at all). 138 of the 217 visible line citations sit OUTSIDE historical blocks and are therefore live pointers, but they are unanchored. The seed was drawn from this session's proven drift cases, not from density alone, and the 21-of-25 blind-spot shapes are deliberate: a shape the extractor cannot see is where a silently-stale citation survives longest, so those carry the most value per anchor. The known-unverified residue, by count and by category (re-measured 2026-10-04): (a) 24 live citations of src/server/mod.rs and 17 of sdk-rpc-client-native.ts — the two densest files, and both had live drift this session (see the two filed findings); (b) ~10 citations of upstream and retired trees via fully-qualified paths, which analyzeLedger short-circuits before checked++ and therefore NEVER existence-tests today; (c) the remainder of the 60 distinct live paths — 52 of them cited 1-2 times (41 once, 11 twice), against 8 cited 3+ times (src/server/mod.rs 24, sdk-rpc-client-native.ts 17, src/main.rs 10, src/session/mod.rs 8, src/napi_bindings.rs 7, src/mcp/manager.rs 3, node-sdk/src/types.ts 3, src/server/engine.rs 3). A follow-on mission should extend the manifest from (a) and (b) first — they are where a defect is both most likely and most costly.
